title: #3448 the wait that had nowhere to land: auto-backgrounded Bash is not run_in_background
description: A brainstorm teammate's foreground Bash call was auto-backgrounded on timeout; the agent ended its turn on 'I'll wait' and the output was lost silently. SKILL.md now scopes the turn-end survival claim to run_in_background tasks, moves long research to the lead, and bars ending a turn on an uncollected wait.
